content.summary: שואב אבק אלחוטי מסוג מקל של Zanussi, דגם ZHS-32802, לשאיבה יבשה ללא שקית. מתאים למי שמחפש שואב קל לניקוי יומיומי בלי חוט.
goodFor: ניקוי מהיר ויומיומי בלי לחפש שקע
בתים עם רצפות ושטיחים, בזכות מברשת LED משולבת לרצפה ולשטיח
מי שרוצה סינון HEPA בשואב אלחוטי
אחסון מסודר על הקיר עם מחזיק אביזרים
considerations: השואב מיועד לשאיבה יבשה בלבד ולא לנוזלים

reviewFlags.issue: The catalog model ZHS-32802 appears on no page by itself. The only pages found name colour-coded variants (ZHS-32802-BL and ZHS-32802-YL), so the base model is unconfirmed.

No Israeli importer page, Israeli spec sheet or manufacturer page for this model was found. All quotes come from a UK retailer and an Egyptian retailer, so the Israeli variant and its specs are unclear.
The Amazon.eg page also lists the voltage as 20 Volts in its table and as 222V in a bullet. The 22.2 V value rests on the retailer description text and the Quzo page.
An Israeli comparison listing in search results gives a 0.8 liter container, while the Quzo page gives 1 L. The sources conflict.
The Quzo page gives 1100 x 250 x 215 mm without naming the axes. The width × height × depth order is assumed and should be checked.
14.5 l/s and the 2200mAh battery come from one UK retailer only, so they are not corroborated by a second site.
A UK page gives an initial release date of 18/03/2021, so the model may be old or discontinued. Confirm the current model before relying on these specs.
All sources name colour variants ZHS-32802-BL and ZHS-32802-YL; the base catalog model and its Israeli variant are unconfirmed.
Quzo spec line gives 22.5 V while description text on Quzo and Amazon.eg gives 22.2 V.
An Israeli comparison listing reportedly gives 0.8 L versus 1 L on Quzo; verify.
Source gives 1100 x 250 x 215 mm without axis names.
A UK page lists an initial release date in 2021; check whether the model is still current.
